summary: iter135 re-test: the claimed frontend fix WAS NOT APPLIED. /app/frontend/src/lib/useTeam.js is byte-identical to the previous iteration (mtime Aug 30, not listed in `git status -s` modified files) and still derives sousTraitants exclusively from GET /users filtered on role==='sous_traitant'; it never calls GET /team?type=sous_traitant and there is no _account_less flag anywhere in the codebase. SousTraitantList.removeRole() still unconditionally calls PUT /users/{id}. Reproduced end-to-end in the UI: adding a sous-traitant with a name only shows the success toast 'TEST_QA_ST_R2_85398 ajouté comme sous-traitant (sans compte)' but the entry does NOT appear in the list, the badge stays at 1, and it is still absent after a full page reload. Backend regression is green: 7/7 pytest pass (create no-email 200, duplicate 400, invalid type 400/422, blank name 400/422, email persisted, delete, non-admin 403).

ui_bugs.issue: Remove button testid is `sous-traitant-{id}-remove`, not the `team-sous-traitant-{id}-remove` stated in the request — align naming or update the spec.

integration_issues.flow: Add sous-traitant without email (Users page > Sous-traitants block)
integration_issues.issue: UNCHANGED FROM ITERATION 23 — fix not present in the codebase. POST /api/team returns 200 and the toast appears, but useTeam.js (lines 17-27) only reads GET /users (role==='sous_traitant'), so the team_members record is never fetched: invisible immediately and after reload, counter badge does not increment.
Untestable (such entries never render) and still incorrect in code: removeRole() calls PUT /users/{id} for every entry; it must call DELETE /api/team/{id} for team_members-sourced entries.

action_items: APPLY the useTeam.js change — it is missing on disk. load() must also `api.get('/team?type=sous_traitant')` and merge those records with users having role 'sous_traitant', de-duplicating by lowercased email or normalized name, tagging team_members-sourced entries with _account_less=true.
Update SousTraitantList.removeRole() to branch: DELETE /api/team/{id} when m._account_less, else PUT /api/users/{id} {role:'technicien'}.
Verify the change actually lands on disk (git status showed only backend/server.py and TeamSection.jsx modified) before requesting a retest.
critical_code_review_comments: Two sources of truth for sous-traitants (users.role vs team_members.type) with no reconciliation; the no-email path still produces records the UI cannot see.
No cross-collection duplicate check: the same person can be added once via POST /users (email path) and once via POST /team (no-email path).
